slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Good cyber security starts with the fundamentals

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Cyber threats exploit simple weaknesses rather than sophisticated attacks. The controls that matter most are often the everyday ones, how accounts are set up, how devices are updated and how access is managed across your business.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: We help organisations prepare for Cyber Essentials by reinforcing those foundational security controls and streamlining the certification process, so the standard becomes something your business genuinely meets rather than a box to tick.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We assess your environment against the standard first, tell you honestly how close you already are, then close the gaps and take you through certification. We are a team of five engineers supporting more than 30 UK businesses, from two-user teams to organisations of 150+ users. WhizzIT is Cyber Essentials certified and a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider, so our security fundamentals are independently assessed rather than simply claimed.
